title: Asset Root Config
description: Where finished media lives, and where film folders live when no films root is set. Null keeps media in the production folder, wherever that folder is. Setting a path does not move existing files.

asset_root.description: Folder on disk for finished media. Null means the production folder, wherever that folder lives.

films_root.description: Folder that holds each film's working folder. Null means MOVIE_SWARM_FILMS_ROOT, then the asset root. A name passed as a production is this folder plus the name.

env_var.description: Environment variable that overrides asset_root when it is set.
